name: Smriti
role: Foundation, accounts, catalog, departures, coupons, reviews and seeds

tasks.title: Step 0: folders, GitHub repository, tracker site and GitHub Pages
tasks.note: Initial repository setup and automated pages publishing
tasks.instruction: Set up the git repository folder structure tracker web site and configure GitHub Pages automated workflow.
tasks.request: git push origin main and verify GitHub Pages workflow
tasks.response: GitHub Pages publishes tracker site successfully at project URL.

tasks.title: Step 1: settings, URLs and root files
tasks.note: Django project settings and base routing
tasks.instruction: Configure Django project settings installed apps base URL routing and environment variable handling.

tasks.title: Step 2: core app (errors, response wrapper, paging, permissions, token check)
tasks.note: Core response renderer exceptions and pagination
tasks.instruction: Build the core shared application with standard JSON response renderer error handlers custom exceptions and pagination classes.
tasks.request: Trigger application exception or request paginated page
tasks.response: Standard JSON envelope returned with success boolean and data or error details.

tasks.title: Step 3: models part 1 (accounts, catalog)
tasks.note: User and catalog database schema definitions
tasks.instruction: Create database models for custom user accounts categories guides tours tour pictures and FAQs.
tasks.response: Migrations created for accounts and catalog tables.

tasks.title: Step 4: models part 2 (departures, coupons, bookings, reviews) and migrations
tasks.note: Departures coupons bookings and reviews database models
tasks.instruction: Create database models for tour departures discount coupons customer bookings and reviews.
tasks.response: All database tables created successfully in SQLite.

tasks.title: Step 5: helper stubs, empty URL files, empty seed commands, Phase 0 pull request
tasks.note: Helper function stubs and empty route definitions
tasks.instruction: Set up empty URL files helper stubs and empty seed commands then create the Phase 0 pull request.
tasks.response: Core test suite passes and Phase 0 pull request merged.

tasks.title: POST /auth/register
tasks.note: Customer account registration endpoint
tasks.instruction: Create new customer accounts with validated full name email and password. Save email in lowercase and ensure email is not already taken.

tasks.title: POST /auth/login
tasks.note: User authentication and token generation
tasks.instruction: Authenticate user credentials and generate a bearer token. Return the token and user profile.

tasks.title: POST /auth/logout
tasks.note: Session logout and token invalidation
tasks.instruction: Log out the active user session and invalidate or delete their auth token.

tasks.title: GET /users/me
tasks.note: Active user profile retrieval
tasks.instruction: Return the authenticated user profile information matching the bearer token.

tasks.title: PUT /users/me
tasks.note: User profile update endpoint
tasks.instruction: Update the authenticated user profile fields such as full name and phone number.

tasks.title: GET /tours
tasks.note: Public tours listing with filtering and sorting
tasks.instruction: List active tours with filtering by search keyword location category minimum price maximum price and sorting.

tasks.title: GET /tours/{id}
tasks.note: Single tour detailed overview
tasks.instruction: Retrieve detailed information for a single active tour including images guide FAQs and upcoming departures.

tasks.title: GET /categories
tasks.note: Alphabetical category list
tasks.instruction: Return all tour categories sorted alphabetically by category name.

tasks.title: GET /guides/{id}
tasks.note: Guide profile with language skills
tasks.instruction: Return guide profile by identifier with spoken languages formatted as a list.

tasks.title: GET /admin/tours
tasks.note: Admin list including archived tours with search filters
tasks.instruction: Return paginated list of all tours including archived ones with status and keyword filters for administrators.

tasks.title: POST /admin/tours
tasks.note: Create active tour returning full detail representation
tasks.instruction: Create a new tour with title description location category price duration and meeting point details.

tasks.title: PUT /admin/tours/{id}
tasks.note: Partial and full tour updates with immutable pricing on existing bookings
tasks.instruction: Update tour details without mutating historical pricing already stored on confirmed bookings.

tasks.title: PATCH /admin/tours/{id}/status
tasks.note: Update status to active or archived
tasks.instruction: Change tour status between active and archived to hide or show it in public listings.

tasks.title: POST /admin/tours/{id}/images
tasks.note: Multipart file upload with size and format validation
tasks.instruction: Upload tour photograph file validate format and file size and store file under media tours folder.
tasks.request:
POST /api/v1/admin/tours/1/images
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

image_file=@photo.jpg; alt_text=Lake view; sort_order=1

tasks.title: DELETE /admin/tour-images/{id}
tasks.note: Delete tour image and remove file from storage
tasks.instruction: Delete tour image record from database and clean up the stored file from media storage.

tasks.title: POST /admin/tours/{id}/faqs
tasks.note: Create FAQ item for specific tour
tasks.instruction: Create frequently asked question and answer item for a specific tour.

tasks.title: PUT /admin/faqs/{id}
tasks.note: Update FAQ question answer or sort order
tasks.instruction: Update question text answer text or display sort order for an existing tour FAQ item.

tasks.title: DELETE /admin/faqs/{id}
tasks.note: Delete FAQ item by ID
tasks.instruction: Delete a tour FAQ item by identifier from the database.

tasks.title: POST /admin/guides
tasks.note: Create guide with languages list stored as comma separated text
tasks.instruction: Create a new guide profile with name bio picture URL and spoken languages.

tasks.title: PUT /admin/guides/{id}
tasks.note: Update guide profile and language skills
tasks.instruction: Update an existing guide profile details and spoken language skills.

tasks.title: POST /admin/categories
tasks.note: Create category with unique case insensitive name validation
tasks.instruction: Create a tour category ensuring category names are unique and not case sensitive.

tasks.title: GET /tours/{id}/departures
tasks.note: Upcoming scheduled departures soonest first with seats taken
tasks.instruction: Return scheduled upcoming departures for a tour ordered soonest first with seats taken and open status.

tasks.title: GET /departures/calendar
tasks.note: Monthly departures calendar excluding cancelled departures
tasks.instruction: Return monthly calendar of departures excluding cancelled trips with tour titles and seat counts.

tasks.title: POST /admin/tours/{id}/departures
tasks.note: Create scheduled departure with future date validation
tasks.instruction: Create a scheduled departure validating future start date positive capacity and deadline before start date.

tasks.title: PUT /admin/departures/{id}
tasks.note: Update capacity with conflict check preventing reduction below seats taken
tasks.instruction: Update capacity start date or deadline preventing capacity reduction below already booked seats.

tasks.title: PATCH /admin/departures/{id}/status
tasks.note: Status change with atomic completion cascading to approved bookings
tasks.instruction: Update departure status to completed or cancelled. When marked completed cascade to approved bookings.

tasks.title: POST /coupons/validate
tasks.note: Validate coupon code against subtotal returning discount and new total
tasks.instruction: Validate coupon code without using it. Check expiry active flag and usage limit to calculate discount amount.

tasks.title: GET /admin/coupons
tasks.note: Admin coupon list ordered by newest created first
tasks.instruction: Return paginated list of all coupons ordered newest first for administrators.

tasks.title: POST /admin/coupons
tasks.note: Admin create coupon with unique uppercase code and discount validation
tasks.instruction: Create a new discount coupon saving code in capitals and validating discount value and future expiry.

tasks.title: PUT /admin/coupons/{id}
tasks.note: Admin coupon update supporting partial field changes
tasks.instruction: Update coupon attributes such as active flag discount value or usage limit while keeping code immutable.

tasks.title: GET /tours/{id}/reviews
tasks.note: Public tour reviews list with paging and formatted reviewer names
tasks.instruction: Return paginated customer reviews for a tour ordered newest first with reviewer formatted as first name and last initial.

tasks.title: POST /reviews
tasks.note: Customer review creation validated against completed booking
tasks.instruction: Create a review for a completed tour booking. Check booking ownership completion and disallow duplicate reviews.

tasks.title: GET /admin/reviews
tasks.note: Admin review list with filters for tour and rating
tasks.instruction: Return paginated review list for administrators with optional tour identifier and rating filter.

tasks.title: Step 12: seed_core, seed_reviews, seed_all and constants.py
tasks.note: Populate fifteen tours thirty images accounts departures and coupons
tasks.instruction: Build seed management commands to populate fifteen tours thirty pictures five users departures and five test coupons.
tasks.response: Successfully seeded core catalog departures coupons and reviews without duplicates.

tasks.title: Step 13: README
tasks.note: Project documentation folder layout seed commands and test guides
tasks.instruction: Document setup instructions reset steps seeded user accounts test execution instructions and folder layout in simple English.
tasks.response: Complete setup guide test guide seed tour catalog and Postman documentation.
